description: Prepare an import of what the user owns and owes: one row per current holding, not their transaction history. Saves a draft only. Nothing is added until the user reviews and imports it in Krosos, so this works on a read-only connection. asset is one of the asset classes in get_reference_data. Amounts are in base_currency: convert first. Cash: ticker is the currency code and quantity the balance. A pension pot: ticker is the currency code and quantity the amount. A home, a car or another valuable: a short ticker of its own, quantity 1, and value what it is worth today. What is owed (mortgage, debt, provision): quantity is the amount owed. invested is the cost basis (0 if unknown).

value.description: Pension, valuables and property only: what the holding is worth today in total, in the base currency. On a ticker of its own (a home, a car) it sets the price when the ticker has none, and must match the price it already has. On the base currency it must equal quantity
